title: Call recaps — open models on Token Factory?
subtitle: AI Initiative Canvas · 2026-10-19 · unattended run, assumptions labelled

verdict.label: REFRAME → GO on a 1–2-week bake-off
verdict.summary: As a cost move the LLM switch saves ~$60/month (~3% of MRR); transcription costs ~3–9× more and stays with AssemblyAI. Test non-inferiority on a 60-call golden set; migrate only if an open model matches GPT-4o on action items; park fine-tuning.

pattern: Content generation with structured (JSON) action items: not RAG, not agentic

1.text: ~1,500 audio h/month (~2,000 calls) from ~120 teams at a flat $15. COGS ~$2.4–5.2 per subscriber, mostly transcription. Lever: cost reduction (weak: ~$60/mo on the LLM step).

2.text: Primary: AI COGS ≤ $3.75 per subscriber; churn ≤ baseline. Secondary: summary tickets ≤ baseline. Stop: no candidate passes H1–H2 by week 2 → stay on GPT-4o.

3.text: For small-team members leaving a call with scattered commitments: a trusted recap and action list with owner and date, better than manual notes or re-listening.

4.text: One-time 3–6 dev-days; transcription $225–555/mo + LLM $65/mo. Unit: COGS per subscriber. Breakpoint: users >18–39 h/mo. ROI: saves ~$600–720/yr, payback ~1.7–3.7 yrs.

5.text: Own team → 5–10 opt-in beta users → 20% canary → all. Gates: thumbs-up and edit rate within 5 pp of GPT-4o; no rise in summary tickets.

6.text: The existing product, unchanged: after each recorded call the team gets a summary and action items (owner, due date). Only the engine behind it changes.

7.text: Transcript → one generation pass → summary + JSON action items. Prompt-tuned open model → LoRA only for a proven failure mode with consented data. Risks: invented owner/date, missed commitments.

8.text: Action-item recall ≥90%, precision ≥85%; summary ≥ GPT-4o in ≥80% of blind pairs. p95 ≤60 s per 1 h call; valid JSON ≥99%.

9.text: Offline: 60-call golden set. Live: shadow on real calls → canary with GPT-4o one flag away. Roll back if edit or thumbs-down rate is +5 pp for a week.

10.text: Review / Edit / Reassign / Jump to transcript / Regenerate. AI label, timestamp evidence, 'owner unclear' flags. Transcript only, zero-retention, opt-in training.

11.text: Where are transcripts stored and for how long? Can we replay them for evals within the retention policy?

12.text: What runs the 60-call golden set on every prompt or model change, and where are results versioned?

13.text: One provider abstraction (OpenAI SDK + base_url) so a model swap is a config change? Who owns it?

14.text: Feature flag and per-user routing GPT-4o ↔ open model; fallback on timeout or invalid JSON?

15.text: Alerts on JSON failures, p95, cost per call, thumbs-down rate. Who responds?

next_step: Offline bake-off: GPT-4o vs gpt-oss-120b, a 70B+ open model, Nemotron-Lightning and GPT-4o-mini (control) on 60 labelled calls (30 opt-in + 30 AMI/ICSI); action items + summary from existing transcripts.
